_description: Curated external anchors per region for S1 Technical Validation. Seeded from code comments in src/data/*.json.ts and docs/data-source-log.md on 2026-04-24; enrich iteratively as paper-grade sources are confirmed.

_fields.tso_annual_latest: Human-readable most-recent TSO-published annual curtailment, e.g. 'ERCOT ~8 TWh (2024, Potomac Economics SoM)'
_fields.tso_annual_twh: Dict of year→TWh numeric where known: {'2024': 8.0}
_fields.other_anchor: Any other high-quality public source (GGFR for flare, etc.)
_fields.limitations: Region-specific limitations to surface in the validation doc
_fields.discrepancy_discussion: Optional override for the discrepancy narrative

caiso.tso_annual_latest: CAISO ~3.4 TWh solar + ~0.5 TWh wind (2024, Ascend Analytics / CAISO daily reports)
caiso.other_anchor: Ascend Analytics, CAISO daily curtailment reports

ercot-west.tso_annual_latest: ERCOT ~8 TWh wind + ~0.8 TWh solar (2024, Potomac Economics State of the Market)
ercot-west.limitations: West/East split (66/34) is illustrative only — no public ERCOT zonal dispatch-down series was found as of 2026-04. Rate calibration is ERCOT-wide.

ercot-east.tso_annual_latest: ERCOT ~8 TWh wind + ~0.8 TWh solar (2024, Potomac Economics SoM) × 34% East/Central share

pjm.tso_annual_latest: PJM small but growing curtailment, concentrated in NJ/MD/VA solar (2024 PJM State of the Market)
pjm.other_anchor: PJM Renewable Integration Study 2024; PJM Markets Monitor 2024

miso.tso_annual_latest: MISO ~5 TWh wind + ~0.5 TWh solar (2024 State of the Market, Potomac Economics)

spp.tso_annual_latest: SPP ~3 TWh wind on ~75 TWh generation (2024 SoM)

permian.tso_annual_latest: GGFR 2024 Permian flaring ~280 Bcf ≈ 82 TWh equivalent (base load, 24/7)
permian.limitations: Flare regions are intrinsically base-load by nature. Hourly shape is flat by definition. 'Curtailment' here is the economic choice to flare rather than utilise — not grid-driven curtailment.

w-siberia.limitations: Base-load flare region — see permian for flat-shape rationale.

gansu.tso_annual_latest: Ember China 2024 Gansu wind+solar curtailment ~12 TWh

sichuan.tso_annual_latest: Ember China 2024 Sichuan ~8 TWh hydro spill
sichuan.limitations: Structural gap — see gansu. Hydro spill is seasonal (spring melt), not diurnal; hourly shape is near-flat by design.
